title: Partial Modal Tensor Regression
abstract: arXiv:2610.34008v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: With the rapid development of modern scientific research, tensor data have become increasingly prevalent across a wide range of fields. How to effectively characterize the relationship between tensor predictors and a response while preserving the intrinsic structure of tensor data has therefore become an important problem in high-dimensional statistical analysis. Existing tensor regression methods mainly focus on conditional means or conditional quantiles. When the response distribution is asymmetric, heavy-tailed, or contaminated by outlying observations, the conditional modal provides a robust and interpretable alternative characterization. In this paper, we propose a partial modal tensor regression (PMTR) method. The proposed method constructs the partial modal tensor covariance, which incorporates information on the conditional modal to guide tensor dimension reduction, and subsequently establishes a modal tensor regression model in

translated_abstract: 随着现代科学研究的快速发展，张量数据在众多领域中日益普遍。因此，如何在保留张量数据内在结构的同时，有效刻画张量预测变量与响应变量之间的关系，已成为高维统计分析中的一个重要问题。现有的张量回归方法主要关注条件均值或条件分位数。当响应变量的分布呈现非对称、重尾或受到异常观测污染时，条件模态提供了一种稳健且可解释的替代性刻画方式。在本文中，我们提出了一种部分模态张量回归（PMTR）方法。该方法构造了部分模态张量协方差，将条件模态信息纳入其中以指导张量降维，并在此基础上建立了模态张量回归模型……
tldr: 提出部分模态张量回归方法（PMTR），通过构造融合条件模态信息的部分模态张量协方差来指导张量降维，为非对称、重尾或含异常值的响应数据提供稳健且可解释的张量回归建模方案。
en_tdlr: Proposes a partial modal tensor regression (PMTR) method that constructs a partial modal tensor covariance incorporating conditional modal information to guide tensor dimension reduction, providing a robust and interpretable tensor regression framework for asymmetric, heavy-tailed, or outlier-contaminated response data.
